title: Grazia Deledda's birth chart
metaDescription: Grazia Deledda's chart, computed from a sourced birth date: Sun at 3.9° Libra. Birth time unknown, so no houses or rising sign.
lede: Tightest of all, the Sun holds a square to Saturn at 0.3° — close enough to weld identity to structure. A square is friction that produces motion — the aspect the tradition credits with building capability precisely by refusing to be comfortable.

blocks.title: Where the Sun actually stood
blocks.text: At the noon reference the Sun sits 3.9° into Libra — the first decan, which the old scheme hands to Venus. Same sign, different decan, different chart.

blocks.title: Closer to the ground
blocks.text: The personal planets sit Mercury at 18.5° Virgo, Venus at 2.3° Libra. Mercury in a earth sign reads as thought with its feet on the ground; Venus in a air sign reads as attraction that begins as conversation.

blocks.title: The angles that hold
blocks.text: Nothing in the geometry sits closer than the Sun and Saturn: 0.3° from an exact square. Right angles are where the scheme puts its grit. A square asks two functions to work in a mode neither would have chosen. Behind it, Mars trine Uranus at 0.4°, and Mercury trine Pluto at 1.2° — both still well inside the orbs this site uses. The unknown hour cannot unmake any of this: every aspect named survived all twenty-five samples of the day.

blocks.title: Figures in the geometry
blocks.text: No closed figure — no grand trine, t-square, or grand cross — holds among the day-stable angles. The chart distributes its tension pair by pair rather than through one standing structure.

blocks.title: The classical map
blocks.text: Read against the old dignities, five placements stand out. The Sun in Libra at 3.9° is in fall — the tradition’s uphill placement, strength earned rather than given; Mercury in Virgo at 18.5° is in exaltation — the tradition’s honoured-guest placement, working at its best; Venus in Libra at 2.3° is in domicile — the planet in its own sign, running on home rules; Jupiter in Cancer at 26.1° is in exaltation; Saturn in Capricorn at 3.6° is in domicile. Dignity is a statement about conditions, not about worth.

blocks.title: The shape of the whole
blocks.text: Balance, counted honestly across the 9 placements whose signs hold for the whole day: elements earth 3, air 2, water 2, fire 2; modalities cardinal 5, mutable 2, fixed 2. An earth emphasis reads as patience with material reality — slow hands, durable results. Mars crossed from Scorpio into Sagittarius during that day, so its sign is left open. Venus, Neptune and Pluto were retrograde — apparent backward motion from where the Earth sits, which the tradition reads as a function turned inward before it is turned out.

blocks.title: The Moon, and how far it can move
blocks.text: The Moon stayed in Pisces for the whole of that day at the birthplace, covering 13.5° between midnight and midnight. Fast enough that its degree is approximate, slow enough that its sign is not in doubt. At the noon reference it stands at 18.1°.
